note: Locked coverage set of 31 individually-verified Options-Integrated (OI) and comparison tickers. Not organically grown — see AGENTS.md 'Coverage model'. Wrapper instruments preferred over individual monthly-dated rungs of the same strategy.

benchmark_anchors.note: Computed for every tracked ticker, always. Used for Lens C cross-fund comparison.
Used where a fund's own literature names the Nasdaq-100.
Used where a fund's own literature names the Russell 2000 / small-cap segment.
iShares MSCI EAFE ETF. Used where a fund's own literature names MSCI EAFE. Added by 3F D-01, which closed benchmark_gap.

benchmark_gap.issue: These three funds explicitly name MSCI EAFE as their reference. No EAFE-tracking instrument was in benchmark_anchors, so they were computed against VOO only, which does not match their claimed exposure.
benchmark_gap.resolution: EFA (iShares MSCI EAFE ETF) added as a fourth anchor. All three now carry named_benchmark: "EFA". Retained rather than deleted so the reasoning stays legible.
